Incident Type: UNKNOWN SHEEN
Material: UNKNOWN OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 29.021944, -90.271389 (Explicit)
Report DescriptionPOSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE ANOMALY WAS SLENDER AND LINEAR IN SHAPE. THE DIMENSIONS OF THE ANOMALY WERE APPROXIMATELY 16.29NM IN LENGTH AND 0.17NM AT ITS WIDEST POINT. THERE WERE A CLUSTER OF OIL FACILITIES TO THE EAST OF THE ANOMALY, BUT NONE WERE DIRECTLY CONNECTED TO THE ANOMALY. THE ANOMALY WAS DARK IN COLOR AND HAD A HIGH CONTRAST WITH THE SURROUNDING WATERS. AT THE TIME THIS IMAGE WAS TAKEN WINDS WERE SE AT 10KTS, WHICH ALIGNED WELL WITH THE ORIENTATION OF THE ANOMALY. UNCERTAINTIES: WE COULD NOT SPECIFY AN EXACT POINT SOURCE SO THE MARKER WAS PLACED NEAR THE OIL FACILITIES TO THE EAST. THERE WAS ALSO A POSSIBILITY THAT THE ANOMALY WAS RELATED TO BIOGENIC FEATURES. THEREFORE, OUR CONFIDENCE WAS KEPT AT MEDIUM-HIGH.

properties.summary: Incident Type: CONTINUOUS - NRC Report ID: 884249 - Medium Affected: AIR - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 884249
Incident Time: 2008-09-17 12:00:00
Nearest City: Pueblo, CO
Incident Type: CONTINUOUS
Material: AMMONIUM NITRATE, UREA SOLUTION
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
XCEL ENERGY IS SCHEDULED TO CONDUCT TESTING OF A NOX EMISSIONS CONTROL SYSTEM AT ITS COMANCHE STATION UNIT 2 (COAL FIRED ELECTRIC GENERATING STATION). A TEMPORARY SELECTIVE NON-CATALYTIC REDUCTION (SNCR) NOX CONTROL SYSTEM IS GOING TO BE BROUGHT ON SITE AND TESTED FROM 9-17-08 TO 9-26-08. SNCR IS A TYPE OF NOX EMISSION CONTROLS THAT ACHIEVE REDUCTION BY INJECTING AN UREA OR AMMONIA BASED REAGENT INTO THE FLUE GAS. THE REAGENT REACTS TO FORM NITROGEN AND WATER. THERE IS ALSO SOME UNREACTED AMMONIA THAT IS RELEASED IN THE EXHAUST GAS STREAM KNOWN AS "AMMONIA SLIP". DURING THE OPERATION OF THE CONTROLS THERE IS THE POTENTIAL THAT THE DAILY RQ FOR AMMONIA COULD BE EXCEEDED BECAUSE OF THIS AMMONIA SLIP. IT IS ANTICIPATED THAT THE CONCENTRATION OF AMMONIA WILL RANGE BETWEEN 2 TO 10 PPM, WHICH EQUATES TO A LB/DAY RANGE OF 30 TO 151. BECAUSE THE LEVEL OF AMMONIA SLIP DURING THE TESTING CANNOT BE GUARANTEED AND WILL NOT BE CONTINUOUSLY MONITORED, THE DECISION WAS MADE TO REPORT A CONTINUOUS RELEASE.

REPORT DATE: 05-08-2023 REPORT TIME: 1330 UTC REGION: GULF OF MEXICO SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: BRETON SOUND BS0016 IMAGE DATE: 05-07-2023 IMAGE TIME: 1605 UTC DATA SOURCE: PLANETSCOPE MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 3 METER LOCATION: 29°38"41" N/89°17"43" W AREA: 4.37 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REMARKS: POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THE POSSIBLE OIL SLICK WAS OBSERVED IN THE BRETON SOUND AREA JUST OFF THE LOUISIANA COAST. THE POSSIBLE OIL WAS COMPRISED OF TWO SEPARATE SLICKS. THE WESTERN SLICK MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 2.1NM X 0.9NM, WITH THE EASTERN SLICK APPROXIMATELY 4.5NM X 0.3NM. THE POSSIBLE SLICKS EXHIBITED BRIGHTER REFLECTANCE SURROUNDED BY A DARKER SHEEN. THERE WERE PORTIONS OF THE SLICKS THAT ALSO APPEARED TO HAVE FEATHERING FEATURES, WHICH WAS CONSISTENT WITH THE 10-15KT SE WIND AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGERY. THIS AREA MAY HAVE BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH NRC #1366513 GIVEN ITS CLOSE PROXIMITY TO THE SE. DUE TO THE APPEARANCE IN SATELLITE IMAGERY AND THE NEARBY NRC REPORT, THE CONFIDENCE LEVEL IS HIGH. UNCERTAINTIES: THE FULL EXTENT OF THE POSSIBLE OIL SLICK IS UNKNOWN DUE TO THE AREA EXTENDING PAST THE EDGE OF THE SATELLITE IMAGERY. ADDITIONALLY, A POINT SOURCE COULD NOT BE DETERMINED. properties.summary: Incident Type: AIRCRAFT - NRC Report ID: 1325644 - Medium Affected: AIR - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1325644
Incident Time: 2021-12-31 06:00:00
Nearest City: Portland, OR
Location: 7000 NE AIRPORT WAY
Location2: GATE B3 - PORTLAND AIRPORT - PDX
Incident Type: AIRCRAFT
Material: LITHIUM; LPATOP BATTERY
Medium Affected: AIR
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 45.589201, -122.593477 (Approximated from street_address)
Report DescriptionCALLER STATES THAT DURING LUGGAGE LOADING, A BURNING SMELL AND SMOKE WAS DETECTED COMING FROM THE LOWER HOLD IN PIT 3 OF THE COMMERCIAL AIRCRAFT. UPON INVESTIGATION, AN HP PAVILION 360 LAPTOP WAS DISCOVERED WITH EVIDENCE OF SCORCHING IN A PASSENGER"S BAG. THIS RESULTED IN THE LAPTOP MELTING ONTO AN AIR DRYER WITHIN THE BAG, CAUSING FUMES AND SMOKE TO BE RELEASED TO THE AIR. THE SMOKE CAUSED A MILD DIZZYING EFFECT TO SOME EMPLOYEES. THE LAPTOP AND BAG WERE REMOVED AND QUARANTINED INSIDE AN OFFICE. THE REST OF THE LUGGAGE CONTENTS WERE TRANSFERRED TO A NEW BAG AND PUT BACK ON THE FLIGHT. THIS CAUSED A 45 MINUTE DELAY FOR THE FLIGHT.

Report Description
///WEB REPORT/// A MINISCULE AMOUNT OF OIL WAS DISCOVERED AT 0812 THIS MORNING IN THE TAIL RACE IN FRONT OF UNIT # 1. ALTHOUGH THE SOURCE CANNOT BE VERIFIED AT THIS TIME, IT IS BELIEVED THE SHEEN MOST LIKELY CAME FROM UNIT #1 WHICH WAS PLACED OUT OF SERVICE ON 2/15/13 AT 1930 DUE TO EXCESSIVE VIBRATION. UNDER SUPERVISION THE UNIT WAS RESTARTED ABOUT 40 MINUTES LATER AT 2007 AND STOPPED AT 2011. ALL OIL LEVELS WERE CHECKED AFTER THIS INCIDENT ON THE 15TH AND NO DECREASES IN OIL LEVELS WERE FOUND. OIL ACCOUNTABILITY WILL BE DONE AGAIN TODAY TO VERIFY OIL LEVELS. BECAUSE THE CAUSE OF THE EXCESSIVE VIBRATION IS UNKNOWN IT IS DIFFICULT TO ACCURATELY IDENTIFY THE SOURCE OF THE SHEEN. TODAY, MECHANICS WILL WORK TO PUT STOP LOGS AND HEAD GATES IN PLACE SO THEY MAY GAIN ACCESS TO INVESTIGATE THE INCIDENT THAT HAS OCCURRED. THE SHEEN APPEARED TO BE A COUPLE TABLESPOONS WORTH, ONLY ABOUT 4 INCHES BY 4 INCHES IN A COUPLE DIFFERENT AREAS IN THE TAILRACE. CURRENTLY BOOM IS BEING DEPLOYED TO CAPTURE ANY OIL THAT HAS BEEN DISCHARGED TO THE SNAKE RIVER MILE 70.3.

///WEB REPORT/// A MINISCULE AMOUNT OF OIL WAS DISCOVERED AT 0812 THIS MORNING IN THE TAIL RACE IN FRONT OF UNIT # 1. ALTHOUGH THE SOURCE CANNOT BE VERIFIED AT THIS TIME, IT IS BELIEVED THE SHEEN MOST LIKELY CAME FROM UNIT #1 WHICH WAS PLACED OUT OF SERVICE ON 2/15/13 AT 1930 DUE TO EXCESSIVE VIBRATION. UNDER SUPERVISION THE UNIT WAS RESTARTED ABOUT 40 MINUTES LATER AT 2007 AND STOPPED AT 2011. ALL OIL LEVELS WERE CHECKED AFTER THIS INCIDENT ON THE 15TH AND NO DECREASES IN OIL LEVELS WERE FOUND. OIL ACCOUNTABILITY WILL BE DONE AGAIN TODAY TO VERIFY OIL LEVELS. BECAUSE THE CAUSE OF THE EXCESSIVE VIBRATION IS UNKNOWN IT IS DIFFICULT TO ACCURATELY IDENTIFY THE SOURCE OF THE SHEEN. TODAY, MECHANICS WILL WORK TO PUT STOP LOGS AND HEAD GATES IN PLACE SO THEY MAY GAIN ACCESS TO INVESTIGATE THE INCIDENT THAT HAS OCCURRED. THE SHEEN APPEARED TO BE A COUPLE TABLESPOONS WORTH, ONLY ABOUT 4 INCHES BY 4 INCHES IN A COUPLE DIFFERENT AREAS IN THE TAILRACE. CURRENTLY BOOM IS BEING DEPLOYED TO CAPTURE ANY OIL THAT HAS BEEN DISCHARGED TO THE SNAKE RIVER MILE 70.3.
